posts.title: Recalibrating
posts.description: This is a more personal post than usual, but I think it’s worth writing down. Earlier this year, around March, I had the first proper health scare of my life. I checked myself into the ER and spent a week in the hospital, being monitored and tested. I won’t go into much detail about it here, but it looks like I’m alright now, pending a few final checkups later this month.

posts.title: mkdocs-alias-plugin 0.11.0 Release
posts.description: The latest version, v0.11.0, of the mkdocs-alias-plugin is now available here . posts.title: License Laundering a Copyleft Project
posts.description: Disclaimer: I am not a lawyer; this is not legal analysis, nor legal advice, just an opinion. Mark Pilgrim, the original creator of chardet recently opened a GitHub issue on the project after he found that the project he started was relicensed under the MIT license from the original LGPL, a process generally referred to as license laundering .
